decisions.reason: After two years on the market, the aloe vera line looks like an established close-to-core extension with low incremental carrying cost, so the firm is likely to keep it rather than withdraw it.
The cleansing milk is still a cheap-to-maintain, close-to-core product, but its lower visibility means that another year of weak traction could lead the firm to drop it.
As the newest close-to-core launch, the cleansing oil still has option value because its market potential is not yet fully revealed and the firm can keep testing it at relatively low cost.
